statement: User gets Blender-equivalent 2D view pan, zoom and scroll infrastructure through shared UI infrastructure (13 operators in bpy.ops.view2d), verified by common tests instead of one test per operator.
notes: UI-infrastructure group row. Member operators (13): bpy.ops.view2d.edge_pan = View Edge Pan; bpy.ops.view2d.pan = Pan View; bpy.ops.view2d.reset = Reset View; bpy.ops.view2d.scroll_down = Scroll Down; bpy.ops.view2d.scroll_left = Scroll Left; bpy.ops.view2d.scroll_right = Scroll Right; bpy.ops.view2d.scroll_up = Scroll Up; bpy.ops.view2d.scroller_activate = Scroller Activate; bpy.ops.view2d.smoothview = Smooth View 2D; bpy.ops.view2d.zoom = Zoom 2D View; bpy.ops.view2d.zoom_border = Zoom to Border; bpy.ops.view2d.zoom_in = Zoom In; bpy.ops.view2d.zoom_out = Zoom Out
